sources.title: 50 Years of Persistent Activity: Quo Vadis?
sources.used_for: 持续活动捍卫：多吸引子网络仍然有效；伽马爆发兼容为稀疏同步振荡；活动沉默在主动WM操纵（过滤干扰）中不足；50年历史回顾

sources.authors: Panichello MF, Jonikaitis D, Oh YJ, Zhu S, Trepka EB, Moore T
sources.title: Intermittent rate coding and cue-specific ensembles support working memory
